focus: SAE activation feature disentanglement, not waveform compression; Mirror replaces virtual encoder detector weights; loop implements iterative residual correction

dataset.features: unit-norm isotropic 64x32 ground truth decoder; x = sum of exactly 3 nonnegative latent features plus Gaussian noise sigma=.01
dataset.world_correlated_pairs: train/dev/fresh_id: anchor and neighbor partner XOR1 with probability 0.75, third distinct index; fresh_ood: 3 independent uniform IDs
dataset.separate_generators: seed*100 + split index 0/1/2/3; ground truth dictionary based on seed+world id 10000 or 20000
dataset.data_governance: train on x only; never feed true feature IDs or vectors to optimizer; frozen dev checkpoint selection, fresh evaluation once

optimization.select: min dev normalized MSE; ties choose earlier

model.common_decoder: trainable 64x32 unit-row normalized dictionary plus trainable output bias 32
model.code: TopK(ReLU) with exactly up to 3 active features
model.loop: z0 = TopK(ReLU(E*x+b)); repeat T-1 times z=TopK(ReLU(z + .4 * (x - D*z - outbias) @ E^T))
model.mirror: 8 deterministic signed permutation views of shared 32 core, trainable (64x6) addresses scored with fixed page keys, softmax mix; Householder/tanh/inverse Householder nonlinearity, per-feature learned positive gain
model.affine: identical shared core/pages/address/gains with identity instead of nonlinear Householder/tanh/inverse
model.lowrank: trainable 64x8 times trainable 8x32 plus per-feature gain, exactly same iterations
model.dense_onepass: independent 64x32 encoder and common decoder, T=1
model.dense_loop: same dense encoder and common decoder, T=3

interpretation.alignment: one-to-one Hungarian maximize POSITIVE groundtruth vs learned decoder cosine, then compute true-feature support micro-F1, using only evaluator access to known dictionary; alignment calculated once from checkpoint and true dictionary, never used for training
interpretation.packet: torch.save model state_dict+deterministic program seed as exported replayable payload; report bytes and fixed program generation separately; no optimizer states counted
interpretation.timing: torch no grad 1 CPU thread, warmup 15 steps, 100 runs per batch; report median; host clock unfixed

gates.feature_recovery: mirror_loop improves fresh OOD F1 by >=0.05 absolute over affine_loop and dense_loop in >=5 of 6 paired world-seeds; fresh_id NMSE <=1.10x affine_loop in all pairs
gates.mirror_specific: must beat identical address affine_loop; improvement shared with affine/lowrank is not Mirror-specific
gates.scope: small synthetic screen; 6 paired pairs, no LLM activation evidence, fixed-update not capacity, no interpretability claim beyond known synthetic factors

control_hierarchy: dense single pass, dense iterative, lowrank iterative with more learned params, affine exact-address iterative, Mirror nonlinear iterative
prior_art: Gao et al ICLR 2025 Scaling and Evaluating SAEs
Makelov et al ICLR 2025 principled SAE evaluations
unknowns: gradient interference across shared Mirror pages
